plan.summary:
Refresh now rejects malformed refresh tokens before calling the server.

- `refresh` throws `Malformed refresh token` unless the token matches `/^[\w-]{20,}$/`.
- `maskToken` moves lower in `src/auth/tokens.ts`. Its body is unchanged in the evidence.
plan.riskRationale: Auth token handling changes. A strict regex could reject valid tokens. The change is small. No tests appear in the diff.
plan.storyArc: The main change is a new check in `refresh`. The `maskToken` move is a small reorder in the same file.

noise.reason: Removes `maskToken` from the top of the file. Hunk-1 adds it back with the same body, so this is a move with no runtime effect.

topics.title: Validate refresh token format before fetching
topics.narrativeBrief: What does `refresh` do with a malformed token now? Verify that the regex `/^[\w-]{20,}$/` is the only new rule. Check that `maskToken` is only moved. Check that the throw happens before `fetchTokens` is called.
